query:
SELECT CONCAT(state_code, '-', district_label) as race, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, incumbent, incumbent_party, incumbent_retiring
FROM house_races
WHERE status = 'General' AND (candidate1_name IS NULL OR candidate2_name IS NULL)
ORDER BY state_code, district;
